B. Is this measure already running in Satakunta wellbeing services county (or in the Tyks university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure shorten the time from first symptom to treatment start for lung cancer patients, and by how many days?
Measure: Same-day chest X-ray report with immediate CT. A radiologist or reporting radiographer reads primary-care chest X-rays while the patient waits; if suspicious, CT is done the same day or within days and the referral is triggered by radiology.
effect_summary_en: In the radioX randomised trial (Thorax 2023), immediate reporting of chest X-rays cut the median time from X-ray to lung cancer diagnosis from 63 to 32 days (p=0.03), a saving of 31 days.
supported_en: A randomised trial published in Thorax in 2023 found that immediate reporting halved the median time to diagnosis, from 63 to 32 days.
not_supported_en: The trial is from London, includes only 49 cancers and reports no confidence interval, and nothing shows how many days Satakunta's existing direct-CT pathway already saves.

in_use_summary_en: Satakunta's pathway lets primary care send patients with suspected lung cancer straight to CT without a specialist review first; it began as a pilot in 2022 and became standard practice in 2024 (Satakunnan Kansa, 11 Nov 2026).
missing_en: No page shows that chest X-rays are reported while the patient waits, or that radiology triggers a same-day CT.
summary_en: Satakunnan Kansa reports that since 2024 primary care in Satakunta can send patients with suspected lung cancer straight to CT without a specialist review first; about 170 patients have been scanned this way. No page shows chest X-rays being reported while the patient waits. A 2023 randomised trial in Thorax found that immediate X-ray reporting cut the median time to diagnosis from 63 to 32 days.
unanswered_en: I found no page on whether Satakunta or Tyks report primary-care chest X-rays the same day, and the newspaper article is not the county's own page.
